$comment: Order of the build shown in demo/index.html. Every stable block in components/*.json must be introduced by exactly one step (npm run check enforces it).

steps.title: Lay the baseplate
steps.text: Layout primitives own all spacing, and components never set their own outer margin, so any part fits anywhere. Each dashed outline below is one layout primitive.

steps.title: Seat the buttons in a cluster
steps.text: l-cluster lines parts up in a row that wraps. Primary goes last; destructive actions get the danger brick.

steps.title: Snap on the badges
steps.text: Short status labels. The text carries the meaning; the color only reinforces it.

steps.title: Place cards on the grid
steps.text: l-grid sets the gap. Cards group related content; an interactive card is one real link.

steps.title: Build the form
steps.text: Each field wraps its label, control, help and error. States live in data-state, paired with ARIA.

steps.title: Fit the checks and switches
steps.text: Checkboxes pick any number, radios pick exactly one, a toggle applies straight away. All three keep the native input, so every state is a real attribute, not a class.

steps.title: Raise the signals
steps.text: Alerts are printed notices, not bricks: paper and a keyline, no shadow. Severity shows three ways at once, as a shaped icon, a hidden word and a heavier bottom edge, so it never rests on color.

steps.title: Fit the dialog
steps.text: Prefer a native dialog opened with showModal(). The preview below is contained; the button opens the real thing.

steps.title: Finishing touches
steps.text: Utilities are single-purpose overrides. Reach for them last.
